basic_info.description: Wonderfully sited on one of the best blocks for you to enjoy thriving Outer Sunset living at its best! This highly desirable, sought after location is just a short stroll to a multitude of exquisite, neighborhood dining options, coffee shops & local stores. Walk to Ocean Beach with the pooch, or hop on your bike or other wheeled mode of transit to Golden Gate Park for endless outdoor fun! This well maintained home offers a modern, updated kitchen with ample counter space & newer appliances. There is a formal dining area open to the spacious living room, as well as 2 bedrooms overlooking a nicely landscaped rear yard. Full bathroom with a separate bath & shower complete this level. Stairs lead down to a large bonus space which is arranged as another bedroom & includes another full bathroom. Opportunity to expand further on this level with a separate entrance from the street along the detached south side of the home. Interior access from this level leads to the large garage & storage. The beautiful, level backyard is bathed in sun & is nicely landscaped  with a lawn area, large patio & opportunity to start your own garden. Though the lower level is not warranted living space, the home works very comfortably as a 3 bedroom, 2 bath home. Permit issued for ADU down. Welcome Home!
